canonical_serialization.integer_encoding: big-endian signed 64-bit for body_id; big-endian unsigned 32-bit for counts and UTF-8 byte lengths
canonical_serialization.quantum_encoding: N:<base-10 integer> for integer, D:<original Decimal string> for string, Z: for null; no float encodings
canonical_serialization.bytes: magic, allowed_units_count and sorted LP allowed_units, allowed_interval_methods_count and sorted LP allowed_interval_methods, record_count, then each record body_id, LP record_key/name/category, token_count, each token LP record_key/field/token/tagged quantum/unit/category/locator_key, rule_count, each rule body_id, LP rule_key/variant, operand_count and each operand LP namespace, I64 body_id, LP key, then LP output_category/output_unit/tagged output_quantum/output_exactness/interval_method
canonical_serialization.declaration_encoding: after magic_utf8, each declaration is a U32 item count followed by each sorted item as LP UTF-8; then record_count and record bodies
